question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated during the spring season in Jharkhand when sal trees wear new leaves?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sarhul**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sarhul festival, the most popular tribal celebration across the Jharkhand region, was celebrated on 4 April 2022.
 
• Sarhul means **worshipping trees**. It is celebrated during the spring season when the saal trees wear new leaves
 
• It is celebrated by the tribal communities of the local Sarna religion, most notably by the Munda, Ho, and Oraon tribes.
 
• It is celebrated at the beginning of spring every year in the first month of the Hindu calendar, on the third day of the moon or the fortnight of **‘Chaitra’**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The unmarried tribal girls celebrate the Jawa festival, which has its own kind of song and dance.

 
 
• This is held mainly for the expectation of good fertility and a better household.
 
 
 
• Sohrai is a harvest festival of the Indian states of Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal.
 
 
• It is also called the cattle festival.
 
 
 
• Karam is a harvest festival celebrated in the Indian states of Jharkhand, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Odisha and West Bengal.
